title: BF-CER-v1.0 — private validation only
description: One Apple Silicon Mac, one use case, one report. Synthetic data only during private validation.

device_chip.title: Apple chip
device_chip.description: Exact Apple Silicon chip label, for example Apple M4 Pro.

memory_gib.title: Installed unified memory (GiB)
memory_gib.description: Automatic report supports 8–4096 GiB; physically unsupported profiles are rejected.

use_case.title: Use case
use_case.description: Select one workload to rank the catalog: chat, coding, or reasoning.

preferred_runtime.title: Preferred runtime
preferred_runtime.description: Choose Ollama, MLX, or no preference. Omitted means no preference; commands use only catalog-listed tags.

minimum_context_tokens.title: Minimum context tokens
minimum_context_tokens.description: Positive integer; omitted assumes 16384 tokens. Larger context returns NEEDS_REVIEW without fulfillment.

latency_preference.title: Latency preference
latency_preference.description: Choose quality, balanced, or speed. Omitted means balanced; preferences order existing Beanfit estimates without benchmarking.

installed_runtime_versions.title: Installed runtime versions
installed_runtime_versions.description: Object containing only ollama and/or mlx version strings, e.g. {"ollama":"0.11.0"}. No credentials or logs.

ollama.title: Ollama version
ollama.description: Installed ollama numeric version string only, for example 0.12.3. Never supply credentials or logs.

mlx.title: MLX version
mlx.description: Installed mlx numeric version string only, for example 0.12.3. Never supply credentials or logs.

constraints.title: Workload constraints
constraints.description: At most 500 words; nonempty workload constraints return NEEDS_REVIEW. Never send personal data, secrets, keys, tokens, or logs.
